title: GALVANY — heat pumps sold, installed and then run against dynamic power prices, as one package
money_note: EUR 10M seed announced 2026-06-08 (lead investor SET Ventures' own release, the url), co-led by AENU; stated in EUR, no FX needed.
summary: Berlin-based GALVANY sells, installs (through a contractor and sales-partner network) and then operates heat-pump systems for existing homes, pairing a Panasonic-built heat pump with a battery and an energy-management system that shifts load against dynamic electricity tariffs. It raised a EUR 10M seed round in June 2026 after reporting EUR 20.1M revenue for 2025 and a positive EBIT.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: the buyer is a homeowner (and next, a multifamily owner) replacing a fossil boiler, who today has to assemble a heat pump, an installer, the subsidy paperwork and a tariff by hand. Czech homeowners face the same assembly with NZÚ money attached, so the model transfers. URGENCY 0: the source names no dated instrument. SCALE 2 (households heating with fossil fuel, a sector). RECURRENCE 2 (the operating half is continuous). MATURITY (abroad): ESTABLISHED on the source's own figures — founded late 2022 (just over 3 years) and a public customer count (more than 2,500 systems installed), with EUR 20.1M 2025 revenue. CZ CHECK, Czech-language queries run 2026-09-28: (1) 'tepelné čerpadlo na klíč včetně vyřízení dotace a baterie řízení podle spotové ceny elektřiny'; (2) 'tepelné čerpadlo pro bytový dům SVJ na klíč dodavatel optimalizace dynamický tarif'; (3) 'tepelné čerpadlo online nabídka montáž a vyřízení dotace Nová zelená úsporám celá ČR firma'. FOUND: Woltair s.r.o. (IČO 06770525, ARES datumVzniku 2018-01-16) sells heat pumps and PV installed end-to-end including the subsidy paperwork, in CZ and abroad — already in our own ledger as round-woltair (EUR 20.5M Series A extension, 2023-06-07) and named on p-0002 — competes: direct, maturity: established (over 3 years; Series A). E.ON Energie, a.s. (IČO 26078201, since 2004) sells heat pumps installed with a discount and subsidy guidance (eon.cz/zivnostnici/sluzby/tepelne-cerpadlo/, saved) — competes: direct, maturity: early ON THE TEST (a 2004 national supplier, but this pass receipted only one public buyer line, smlouvy-36838746, and no customer count or licence on the page read; the test is mechanical and is recorded as it returns). AC Heating s.r.o. (IČO 29156203, since 2012) — a Czech heat-pump manufacturer with its own NZÚ subsidy service (the search result ac-heating.cz/nova-zelena-usporam/ returned 404 on re-fetch, saved) — competes: adjacent (manufacturer, not an operator of the household's energy system), maturity: early on the test (since 2012, no second limb receipted). Nano Energies (Nano Energies CZ s.r.o., IČO 28188861) sells dynamic/spot electricity tariffs and flexibility — competes: adjacent (the tariff half, not the heating system), maturity: early on the test (no second limb receipted on this pass). Not found: a Czech seller of the OPERATING half as a product, i.e. an energy-management layer that runs a household heat pump + battery against the spot price as a service; query (1) surfaced only generic FVE-control vendors (SmartSpot for businesses) and installers' marketing copy. That is a sub-niche observation, not a verdict. VERDICT: taken — the install-plus-subsidy package is sold by an established Czech player (Woltair), with E.ON selling the same. POSITIVE CONTROL: (a) ARES name search 'Wultra' (standing register control, run 2026-09-28) -> Wultra s.r.o., IČO 03643174, datumVzniku 2014-12-15; (b) query (3) surfaced AC Heating s.r.o. (IČO 29156203), a known Czech heat-pump maker — the Czech descriptive method surfaces real Czech vendors in this space. PASSED. COMPARABLE FOR: p-0002 (installer back office — GALVANY is the vertically-integrated alternative to selling software to installers) and p-0025 (retrofit execution patchwork).

title: Klinik — software that sorts incoming patient requests by condition and urgency before a clinician sees them
money_note: EUR 2.25M Series A, 2018-05-18, led by Pathena Fund with existing investors (Pathena's own announcement, the url; the same text is on klinikhealthcaresolutions.com). Stated in EUR, no FX needed. The only round with a receipted amount AND date; Klinik's later rounds were not receipted.
summary: Helsinki-based Klinik sells an AI-supported triage tool: patients describe their problem online, and the system classifies each request by condition and urgency and routes it to the right point of care. An Aalto University study of its use at the Myyrmäki health centre in Vantaa found a 14% saving in average service cost per patient.

TRANSFER LOGIC: a GP practice or health centre drowns in phone and e-mail requests of mixed urgency; sorting them before a clinician reads them is the product. Czech GP practices have the same inflow, and the úhradová vyhláška now pays a bonus for online booking (medevio.cz homepage, saved as pages/cz-medevio_cz_.html), so the buyer has a reason to adopt. OUTCOME RECEIPT: klinikhealthcaresolutions.com/ai-brings-a-14-saving-on-average-patient-treatment-costs-says-an-aalto-university-study/ (saved as pages/cand-klinik-ai-brings-a-14-saving-...html) — Aalto University, Myyrmäki health centre, 14% lower average service cost per patient over the first five months. URGENCY 0 (no dated instrument). SCALE 2 (primary care). RECURRENCE 2 (continuous inflow). MATURITY (abroad): ESTABLISHED — founded 2013, Series A in 2018, and named customers (Priory Medical Group, Roxbourne Medical Centre quoted on its site). (IČO 09675400, ARES datumVzniku 2020-11-13) — its page for GPs (medevio.cz/pro-lekare-praktik, saved) says requests are automatically sorted by type and urgency, each request type has its own questionnaire, and acute states are flagged; 'Medevio využívá více než 4 000 lékařů a sester pro více než 1 500 000 pacientů' — competes: direct, maturity: established (over 3 years; public customer count). eZpráva (ezprava.net) — intelligent patient questionnaires delivered into the practice's system — competes: adjacent (data capture, no triage claimed); maturity not assessed (no operator IČO resolved on this pass). KPK software (Dr. HELP) and B&G software (3L Manažer) — ambulatory practice-management systems — competes: adjacent (the record system the triage feeds). title: mika — AI bookkeeping, VAT returns and annual accounts for small companies, checked by trained accountants
money_note: EUR 6M seed announced 2026-09-24 (Vestbee, the url), led by Smedvig Ventures; stated in EUR, no FX needed.
summary: Berlin-based mika runs an AI-native general ledger built for German accounting that processes receipts and payments, categorises and books transactions, and prepares VAT returns, annual accounts and tax filings for small limited companies, with trained accountants reviewing the output. It raised a EUR 6M seed round in September 2026 and reports more than 750 GmbH and UG customers.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: a small s.r.o. owes the same annual cycle in Czechia — bookkeeping, DPH and kontrolní hlášení, závěrka, přiznání — and today buys it either as software it runs itself or as an accountant's hours. mika sells the done-for-you outcome at software cost. URGENCY 0 (none in the source). SCALE 3 (every small company, cross-sector). RECURRENCE 3 would overstate a commercial model; scored 2 (monthly and annual, continuous). MATURITY (abroad): EARLY — founded 2024, so the >=3-years limb fails; traction limb met (750+ paying companies, EUR 1M+ ARR). CZ CHECK, Czech-language queries run 2026-09-28: (1) 'online účetnictví pro s.r.o. s účetní, doklady zaúčtuje umělá inteligence, přiznání k DPH a závěrka'; (2) 'účetní kancelář online AI automatické zaúčtování bankovních pohybů a faktur pro malé firmy měsíční paušál'. FOUND: iÚčto, operated by Direct Accounting s.r.o. (IČO 28499638, ARES since 2008-12-10) — online accounting with AI document recognition, bank import, AND a paid 'Účetní služby' offer (poptávka a ceník účetních služeb); 'Používá přes 40 000 podnikatelů' (iucto.cz, saved) — competes: direct, maturity: established. HCH Consulting s.r.o. (IČO 06130381, ARES since 2017-05-25; its page says accounting and tax services since 1999) sells an 'Online účetnictví' app with AI bank matching plus access to its accountants — competes: direct, maturity: early ON THE TEST (over 3 years, but no customer count, public buyer, funding or certification receipted on the page read — an old firm the test cannot pass, recorded as the test says). MyÚčto.cz (online ERP/accounting with AI document extraction, 'tisíce firem') — competes: adjacent (software sold to firms and accounting offices, no done-for-you service). Digitoo, ÚčtoKrab, ÚčtoRobot, DokladBot, Vytěžovák — AI document extraction into Pohoda/ABRA — competes: adjacent (a tool for the accountant, not the outcome). VERDICT: taken — iÚčto sells software plus accountant service to 40,000+ Czech businesses. POSITIVE CONTROL: (a) ARES name search 'Wultra' (standing register control, run 2026-09-28) -> Wultra s.r.o., IČO 03643174, datumVzniku 2014-12-15; (b) query (2) surfaced iÚčto and MyÚčto, known Czech online-accounting vendors, and query (1) surfaced Ježek software (Duel), a known Czech accounting-software house — the Czech descriptive method surfaces real vendors here. title: Duqu — cash advances against unpaid B2B invoices, paid within 24 hours without selling the invoice
money_note: EUR 1.5M pre-seed announced 2026-09-24 (tech.eu, the url; Vestbee reports the same round the same day), from Curiosity VC and No Such Ventures; stated in EUR, no FX needed.
summary: Amsterdam-based Duqu advances the amount of an outstanding B2B invoice to the business that issued it, usually within 24 hours, while the business keeps ownership of the invoice and its customer relationship. It raised EUR 1.5M pre-seed in September 2026 and also licenses its AI underwriting engine to banks and lenders as a white-label product.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: late B2B payment starves small suppliers of working capital everywhere; the product is fast, per-invoice liquidity without a factoring contract. URGENCY 0. SCALE 3 (every invoicing SME). RECURRENCE 2. MATURITY (abroad): EARLY — founded 2025, pre-seed, no customer count published. CZ CHECK, Czech-language queries run 2026-09-28: (1) 'financování vystavených faktur online peníze do 24 hodin pro malé firmy bez faktoringu'; (2) 'předfinancování neuhrazené faktury odběratel neplatí včas firma dostane peníze hned poplatek'. FOUND: Cashbot, operated by Red Stone Now s.r.o. (IČO 06790887, ARES since 2018-01-23) — finances issued and received invoices from 3,000 CZK, money the same or next day, without informing the customer; 'Cashbot poskytl firmám a OSVČ už více než 25 000 financování v hodnotě přes 1 750 000 000 Kč' (cashbot.cz, saved) — competes: direct, maturity: established. Platební instituce Roger a.s. (IČO 01729462, ARES since 2013-06-05; a ČNB-licensed payment institution) — pays up to 90% of an invoice within 24 hours, invoices from 25,000 CZK (roger.cz/factoring-platba/, saved) — competes: direct, maturity: established. Malcom Finance with Tatra banka (up to 80% within 24 hours, pilot) — competes: direct, maturity not assessed (IČO not resolved on this pass; omitted from players[] rather than guessed). Bibby Financial Services and SMart Credit sell recourse factoring — competes: adjacent (a factoring contract, which Duqu's model avoids). VERDICT: taken — Cashbot and Roger both sell fast single-invoice financing to Czech SMEs at scale. POSITIVE CONTROL: (a) ARES name search 'Wultra' (standing register control, run 2026-09-28) -> Wultra s.r.o., IČO 03643174, datumVzniku 2014-12-15; (b) query (1) surfaced Bibby Financial Services, a known factoring house operating in Czechia — the Czech descriptive method surfaces real vendors here. PASSED. COMPARABLE FOR: no existing record in data/problems/cz/ covers SME working capital; comparison point only.
